01Why now

Why this course, and why now

Agents can now take on routine work across the back office and the front desk. The skill that matters is choosing the right process, connecting it safely to your software, keeping a person in charge of what counts, and measuring what it saves.

04The lab

One process, automated end to end

Automate a real process from your own work, with a person approving what matters. One project, built in steps after each lesson. Each step has instructions, a finished example, a health check, and saves on your device.

The steps

  1. Describe the process and its steps
  2. Decide what the agent may do and what needs approval
  3. Build the agent and connect one tool
  4. Test it on ten real examples
  5. Add a log and a handover
  6. Measure the time saved and write the runbook

What the health check looks for

  • There is an approval before any irreversible action
  • Every run is logged
  • You can state the time saved per week
